summary: Router 0.42.8 closes TM-04's validation gap 'model listings still show concrete names to role-only clients' (ADR-0131, proposed, extends ADR-0052). auth.client_allows is split: client_grant is the grant check without side effects (same logic: no client -> allowed; concrete needs models:true or the internal UI client; a role needs '*', its name or its exposed name in roles), client_allows calls it and counts forbidden and audits a refusal exactly as before (same reason texts, same audit fields). Traced B1: both request-path call sites in proxy.py still call client_allows, so access is unchanged; the API middleware sets request['client'] before handlers run, so the listing sees the same identity. proxy.tags_list(request) is behind /api/tags (proxy.handle_tags), /v1/models and /v1/models/{model} (openai_api, OpenAI and Anthropic form); all four call sites pass the request. It now lists a role only when client_grant allows it, concrete names only when expose_concrete is on and the client may use concrete names, and the decision router's auto entry only when a role is listed. Role exposed names stay in 'seen' for hidden roles, so no concrete model can appear under a hidden role's name. Observe mode without identity sees everything (client_grant returns None), as before. /api/ps and /api/show are unchanged; /api/ps names loaded concrete models and nodes to any client (noted in TM-04). No exception or error-text path added.

tests.evidence: 5 tests OK over the real API app with an enforce configuration: one-role client sees only that role; all-roles client with models:false sees no concrete name; models:true adds it; /v1/models OpenAI and Anthropic form filter alike; /v1/models/{concrete} 404 for the role-only client, 200 for models:true; observe without identity sees everything; the UI client keeps concrete names; listing counts no forbidden request and writes no audit line; a hidden role requested with /api/chat is refused 403 and audited (rejected case). With proxy.py, auth.py and openai_api.py from origin/main 3 of 5 fail.
